parameters.query:
SELECT 
  platform,
  COUNT(*) as total_posts,
  AVG(viral_score) as avg_viral_score,
  AVG(actual_engagement_rate) as avg_engagement,
  SUM(likes) as total_likes,
  SUM(shares) as total_shares,
  SUM(views) as total_views,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_engagement_rate > 0.05 THEN 1 END) as high_performers
FROM post_metrics
WHERE published_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY platform
ORDER BY total_posts DESC;

SELECT 
  model_name,
  COUNT(*) as requests,
  AVG(latency_ms) as avg_latency,
  SUM(cost) as total_cost,
  AVG(quality_score) as avg_quality,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN success = false THEN 1 END) as failures
FROM model_performance
WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY model_name
ORDER BY total_cost DESC;
